verifies.G099-C1: with the id generation setting at sequence a Long primary key (items.id) gets @GeneratedValue with SEQUENCE and a String primary key (codes.code) gets no @GeneratedValue, i.e. generation is applied only to numeric primary keys. The documented choices NONE, SEQUENCE, IDENTITY and UUID are checked individually: SEQUENCE here, UUID by RS-222; NONE and IDENTITY are not checked.

note: items (bigserial key) and codes (varchar key) with the id generation setting at sequence.
